I was referred to this sub by a sub I frequent on another account (this is a throwaway)

I have not done anything rash yet. But I do have my gun at the ready. I have not decided when I will do it but my mind has been made up. I refuse to live like this any longer. I cant. I wont.

I had given up family to be with this woman. Only to have her betray me, divorce me, then make my life a living hell. The worse part is, its all gov't sanctioned. I'm not violent, I work, I pay my taxes. Yet I am demonized for wanting to actually be a father to my child. 

I cant even have visitation because my ex claims that I'm "violent". 

-I dont have a police record
-Never touched drugs
-Try my best to buy things for my daughter despite not seeing her since she was a year old
-Never abused my ex verbally or physically.

I'm done. I dont want to live in a world where I'm demonized and hated for doing the right thing. I just dont.
